title: Ines and the Sigil
author: Juniper Okafor
blurb: Orsen Vane, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
